scope: Root CLI completed-registration ACK delivery and initial Root post-effect source fences
cli_verified: Only fixed original locations, trust, floors and original file descriptors are captured before service start.
The target observer configuration and independently signed selection arrive through a fixed Root-owned late material file after the original service is ACTIVE.
The trigger binds the exact Root PID, boot ID, process start ticks, per-process attempt, descriptor digest and canonical material digest.
Only the original non-Clone enrollment capability can register; it is consumed once and postcondition failures do not turn into a new Reserve attempt.
The CLI wraps service execution with an RAII stop flag, then joins the worker; failure and unwind do not leave the read-only waiter running.
Artifact paths are locators from the authenticated original CURRENT and selection; opened file descriptors are then supplied to the original complete enrollment checks.

cli_findings.location: bin::serve-session deployment worker and join handling
cli_findings.observed: The previous bin emitted the original registration ACK only after the entire Root service returned. An external host could not wait for actual enrollment before late-connect and would race the bounded first exchange.
cli_findings.requested: Emit and flush the original binding only after wait_and_register and all postchecks complete, while the Root service is still running; keep join as result propagation without a second ACK.

initial_verified: The initial purpose uses the original Root writer, authority lease, pinned process and revocation context without adding a Learning profile dependency.
Reserve stores only the original deployment profile; physical CURRENT preparation waits for the exact consumer-side preflight and original unwritten target checks.
Prepare calls the original prepare_initial and verifies the returned original preparation.
Publish requires the exact original preparation, current original grant window, original consumed FinalUse observation and actual target genesis before and after the effect.
Published Observe reads the actual progressed target journal; it does not incorrectly require the target to remain at genesis forever.
Recover exposes only readback of the original operation, not a new Prepare, Publish or nonce.

additional_actual_ownership_check.conclusion: Prepared TaskSource retains the original source journal, witness, identity, fence and data, but no Cell, GenV2, FinalUse consumer or RootSession. Its retained source capability is an in-memory original capability, not an OS-restart token.

cli_incremental_verified: DirectoryPin now retains an actual O_DIRECTORY|O_NOFOLLOW descriptor as well as the original path, identity and canonical-location checks.
MetadataFile checks all 07777 mode bits against 0600; its final file read is followed by original path-stamp and parent checks.
OriginalFile reuses the same retained parent capability and checks it on both sides of its path/descriptor comparison.

The existing actual UID0 broker fixture invokes the production with_original_deployment constructor, waits for the actual child readiness signal, writes the canonical late material and trigger, then invokes production wait_and_register and the original one-shot register.

The replay negative reads the actual previous Publish trigger in later same-PID/boot/start sessions, confirms the attempt is older, applies the same production trigger guard, and checks profile/CURRENT/claim bytes stay equal.
The unchanged CLI bin still arms its RAII stop flag around the original serve call and joins the worker after stop, including error and unwind paths.
The worker emits exactly one original registration binding ACK immediately after actual wait_and_register succeeds, and flushes it while the service continues.
The main thread still stops before joining and propagates the actual result; it no longer delays or repeats the registration ACK.
The manager now directly retains the Arc returned by the original RootAuthorityDirectory::open, fixing the reported type mismatch without reconstructing a directory capability.
test_scope_notes: These are static observations of actual source. No test, formatter, full caller guard or native pass is claimed.
The previous-trigger negative exercises the production trigger guard on real saved bytes; it is not a full malformed-trigger protocol execution through wait_and_register.
The existing fixture uses explicitly synthetic learning/role inputs and does not establish ordinary A/B/C completion, independent production labels or operating-system restart.
Same-PID Root service reopen uses a new attempt and is distinguished from OS process restart.
conclusion: No remaining static blocker found in the reviewed CLI postimages or listed initial Root source bodies. The new initial client is being independently reviewed by runtime_access. Native compilation, actual UID0 parents, and full caller guards remain pending on the final integrated source.
initial_incremental_verified: Recover retains the already opened original Root record and CAS-fences it on actual material, complete profile or CURRENT validation failure.
Actual target genesis/observations and original persisted FinalUse failure are fenced; malformed peer input is not treated as a historical source failure.
The Root transport independently brackets the exact host-store CAS with persisted readback fences.
The core mutator remains Host-only and exact expected-state CAS; a CAS acknowledgement error alone is not relabeled as source corruption.
The controlled ACK-loss hook is cfg(test), has no wire/config selector, and occurs only after the real CAS and all original postconditions.

The new component parent preserves one original nonce claim through published readback, same-process session retirement, actual journal corruption and byte restoration. It explicitly does not claim task completion or OS restart.
